mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_terminal_demand (run_id, batch_id, factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode, source_month, quantity) VALUES (#{runId}, #{batchId}, #{factoryCode}, #{rootMaterialCode}, #{terminalMaterialCode}, #{terminalType}, #{supplyMode}, #{sourceMonth}, #{quantity})

INSERT INTO mrp_terminal_demand (run_id, batch_id, factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode, source_month, quantity) VALUES
(#{item.runId}, #{item.batchId}, #{item.factoryCode}, #{item.rootMaterialCode}, #{item.terminalMaterialCode}, #{item.terminalType}, #{item.supplyMode}, #{item.sourceMonth}, #{item.quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, source_month

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND terminal_type <> 'MACHINE_OUTPUT'
AND (root_material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR terminal_material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT run_id,batch_id,factory_code,root_material_code,terminal_material_code,terminal_type,supply_mode,source_month,SUM(quantity) quantity FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE GROUP BY run_id,batch_id,factory_code,root_material_code,terminal_material_code,terminal_type,supply_mode,source_month ORDER BY factory_code,terminal_material_code,source_month,root_material_code,terminal_type,supply_mode LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE GROUP BY run_id,batch_id,factory_code,root_material_code,terminal_material_code,terminal_type,supply_mode,source_month) grouped

SELECT grouped.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_inventory_pool p WHERE p.batch_id=#{poolBatchId} AND p.factory_code=grouped.factory_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND p.material_code=grouped.terminal_material_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) inventory_pool_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.available_qty),0) FROM mrp_inventory_pool p WHERE p.batch_id=#{poolBatchId} AND p.factory_code=grouped.factory_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND p.material_code=grouped.terminal_material_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) available_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.allocated_qty),0) FROM mrp_inventory_pool p WHERE p.batch_id=#{poolBatchId} AND p.factory_code=grouped.factory_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND p.material_code=grouped.terminal_material_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) allocated_qty, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_stock_risk r WHERE r.batch_id=#{riskBatchId} AND r.run_id=grouped.run_id AND (r.factory_code=grouped.factory_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci OR (r.factory_code IS NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT legacy_d.factory_code) FROM mrp_terminal_demand legacy_d WHERE legacy_d.run_id=r.run_id AND legacy_d.terminal_material_code=r.material_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND legacy_d.terminal_type <> 'MACHINE_OUTPUT')=1)) AND r.material_code=grouped.terminal_material_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND r.resolved_at IS NULL AND (r.warehouse_code IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_inventory_pool p WHERE p.batch_id=#{poolBatchId} AND p.factory_code=grouped.factory_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND p.material_code=grouped.terminal_material_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND p.warehouse_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci=r.warehouse_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci))) warehouse_risk_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.root_material_code) FROM mrp_terminal_demand d WHERE d.run_id=grouped.run_id AND d.factory_code=grouped.factory_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND d.terminal_material_code=grouped.terminal_material_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND d.terminal_type=grouped.terminal_type COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND d.supply_mode=grouped.supply_mode COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) affected_machine_count ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_decision_issue i WHERE i.batch_id=#{issueBatchId} AND i.status='OPEN' AND i.scope_type='MATERIAL' AND (i.factory_code=grouped.factory_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci OR (i.factory_code IS NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT legacy_d.factory_code) FROM mrp_terminal_demand legacy_d WHERE legacy_d.run_id=grouped.run_id AND legacy_d.terminal_material_code=i.scope_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND legacy_d.terminal_type <> 'MACHINE_OUTPUT')=1)) AND i.scope_key=grouped.terminal_material_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) pending_issue_count ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_material_policy_notice n WHERE n.run_id=grouped.run_id AND n.factory_code=grouped.factory_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND n.material_code=grouped.terminal_material_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND n.missing_type IN ('EXPLOSION','BOTH') AND n.default_explosion_confirmed_at IS NULL) pending_policy_count FROM (SELECT run_id,batch_id,factory_code,terminal_material_code,terminal_type,supply_mode,SUM(quantity) quantity FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE GROUP BY run_id,batch_id,factory_code,terminal_material_code,terminal_type,supply_mode) grouped ORDER BY grouped.factory_code,grouped.terminal_material_code,grouped.terminal_type,grouped.supply_mode LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE GROUP BY run_id,batch_id,factory_code,terminal_material_code,terminal_type,supply_mode) grouped
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_inventory_pool WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND factory_code=#{factoryCode} AND material_code=#{materialCode}
SELECT * FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY root_material_code, terminal_material_code, source_month

SELECT batch_id, factory_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, source_month, SUM(quantity) as quantity FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND terminal_type <> 'MACHINE_OUTPUT' GROUP BY factory_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, source_month ORDER BY terminal_material_code, source_month

SELECT run_id, batch_id, factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode, source_month, SUM(quantity) AS quantity FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND terminal_type <> 'MACHINE_OUTPUT' GROUP BY run_id, batch_id, factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode, source_month ORDER BY root_material_code, terminal_material_code, source_month
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mrp_terminal_demand WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND terminal_type <> 'MACHINE_OUTPUT'
